title: EnFractal style preset
description: One complete look: renderer settings, light, palette, time of day and seasons, camera and depth of field, post effects, per-material treatments, handmade geometry, procedural charm and the offline restyle recipe. Owned by the Look track. Stored as game/styles/<preset_id>/v<preset_version>.json. A seed or draft version may be edited in place; once a version is candidate or approved, or anything pins it, its file never changes and a change means a new version file. Rooms and saves pin a preset by id, version and file hash.

status.description: seed: starting values, not reviewed; draft: in development; candidate: submitted for the look gate; approved: passed the look gate; retired: kept for old saves.

method.description: Renderer the preset is designed for. The project setting is integrator-owned; the runtime reports a mismatch rather than failing.

honor_room_lights.description: How strongly captured light hints become real lights: 0 ignores them, 1 uses their estimated intensity.

depth_of_field.description: The player's reach stays crisp; the far room softens; foliage or props very close to the camera blur so the player stays visible.

roles.description: Overrides per material role; roles not listed use the default treatment.

geometry.description: Handmade treatment applied to assets and shell at import or build time.

charm.description: Procedural detail that emerges on surfaces: moss, vines, crumbs, trim. Decoration only; it never changes collision or protection.

restyle.description: Offline per-asset texture restyle recipe for this preset.

allOf.description: The Look lane's x_look_* blocks are typed (review M6): every field of every block is required and checked, and an unknown field in one of them is refused. Other x_ keys stay free, as in every extensions object.

x_look_role_marks.description: How each material role is painted: the pattern, the brush marks and how the role takes light and colour. `default` covers every role not listed.

texture.description: Godot resource path of a painted texture, for example res://assets/art/painterly/textures/ground-paint-v1.png.
